lines: She if rises vibration-natured that breath-going certainly would be indeed; then in absence of breath-vibration not she would be.
l4.sanskrit_cite: sā cedudayate spandamayī tatprāṇagā dhruvam bhavedeva tataḥ prāṇaspandābhāve na sā bhavet
